error_locked: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
error_expired: Form expired. Please reload the page.
mail_title: Mail health (SPF · DKIM · DMARC · MTA-STS · TLS-RPT · BIMI)
mail_hint: Checks every mail authentication mechanism for a domain in one pass and assigns its own 0-100 score.
blacklist_hint: Checks an IP address against 15 public blocklists in parallel. Some operators (e.g. Spamhaus) reject queries from heavily-used public DNS resolvers — that shows up as "could not check", not as a hit. Works around this via the root-server worker with its own resolver.
tls_hint: Connects over TLS to the given host (default port 443), checks the certificate chain against the system trust store, expiry, hostname coverage and the negotiated TLS version.
soa_in_sync: All name servers report the same serial.
soa_out_of_sync: Name servers report different serials — the zone has not fully propagated yet.
prop_consistent: Every queried resolver returned the same answer.
prop_inconsistent: Resolvers disagree — a change is likely still rolling out.
rev_unconfirmed: None of the returned names resolve back to the checked IP.
rev_private: Address is in a private range.
tls_no_details: Certificate details unavailable because the chain is not trusted:
f_spf_ptr: SPF uses the deprecated ptr mechanism — RFC 7208 marks it 'not recommended'.
f_spf_macro: SPF term {term} contains a macro and was not expanded.
f_spf_bad_term: SPF term {term} is not a valid domain.
f_spf_unresolved: SPF include on {domain} could not be queried.
f_spf_void: SPF include on {domain} has no SPF record of its own (counts as a void lookup).
f_spf_multiple: {count} SPF records found — exactly one is allowed, otherwise the result is PermError.
f_spf_long: SPF record is {length} characters long — close to the DNS limit for a single TXT string.
f_spf_no_all: SPF record does not end with an all mechanism.
f_spf_pass_all: SPF ends with +all — that lets any server send on the domain's behalf.
f_spf_neutral_all: SPF ends with ?all (neutral) — provides essentially no protection.
f_spf_softfail_all: SPF ends with ~all (softfail) — a solid stepping stone before -all.
f_spf_fail_all: SPF ends with -all (hard fail) — this is the recommended setting.
f_spf_too_many_lookups: {count} of at most {limit} allowed DNS lookups — the record is PermError and SPF fails for everyone.
f_spf_lookups_tight: {count} of {limit} allowed DNS lookups used — little room left for further includes.
f_dkim_revoked: Selector {selector} is deliberately revoked (p= is empty).
f_dkim_bad_key: Selector {selector}: the public key could not be parsed.
f_dkim_key_weak: Selector {selector}: RSA key with only {bits} bits — clearly too weak.
f_dkim_key_short: Selector {selector}: RSA key with {bits} bits — 2048 bits are recommended.
f_dkim_testing: Selector {selector} is in testing mode (t=y) — receivers do not enforce failures strictly.
f_dkim_missing: Given selector {selector} returns no DKIM record.
f_dkim_none_guessed: None of {count} common selectors returned a record — that proves nothing, DKIM has no way to enumerate selectors.
f_dmarc_multiple: {count} DMARC records found — exactly one is allowed.
f_dmarc_no_policy: DMARC record has no valid p= tag.
f_dmarc_policy_none: Policy p=none — DMARC only collects reports, it does not act.
f_dmarc_policy_quarantine: Policy p=quarantine — flagged mail is sent to spam.
f_dmarc_policy_reject: Policy p=reject — flagged mail is rejected outright.
f_dmarc_sp_none: Subdomains are exempted with sp=none even though the main domain is stricter.
f_dmarc_bad_pct: pct value {value} is not a valid number.
f_dmarc_partial: pct={pct} — only part of the mail is subject to the policy.
f_dmarc_no_rua: No rua report recipient set — no aggregate reports will arrive.
f_mtasts_missing: No MTA-STS record for {domain} — SMTP connections can silently downgrade to plaintext.
f_mtasts_multiple: {count} MTA-STS TXT records found — exactly one is allowed.
f_mtasts_no_id: MTA-STS record has no id tag.
f_mtasts_policy_status: Policy file responded with status {status} instead of 200.
f_mtasts_policy_type: Policy file served content-type {value} instead of text/plain.
f_mtasts_enforce: Mode enforce — non-conforming connections are refused.
f_mtasts_testing: Mode testing — violations are only reported, not enforced.
f_mtasts_mode_none: Mode none — MTA-STS is switched off.
f_mtasts_max_age_short: max_age is only {value} seconds — a short cache time raises downgrade risk.
f_mtasts_no_mx: Policy file contains no mx line.
f_mtasts_mx_uncovered: These MX hosts are not covered by the policy: {hosts}.
f_mtasts_mx_ok: All {count} MX hosts are covered by the policy.
f_tlsrpt_missing: No TLS-RPT record for {domain} — downgrade or certificate failures go unnoticed.
f_tlsrpt_no_rua: TLS-RPT record has no rua report recipient.
f_bimi_no_logo: BIMI record has no l= tag with a logo URL.
f_bimi_logo_status: Logo URL responded with status {status} instead of 200.
f_bimi_logo_type: Logo served content-type {value} instead of image/svg+xml.
f_bimi_logo_ok: Logo is reachable and served as SVG.
f_bimi_no_vmc: No VMC certificate (a= tag) set — most mailboxes will not show the logo without one.
f_mx_missing: No MX records found for {domain} — the domain cannot receive mail.
f_mx_single: Only one MX record — no fallback server if it goes down.
f_mx_no_address: MX host {host} does not resolve to an A/AAAA address.
f_rbl_clean: Not listed on any of the {count} checked blocklists.
f_rbl_provider_blocked: {count} blocklists could not be checked reliably — operator rejected the query: {lists}.
f_rbl_errors: {count} blocklists did not answer in time.
f_tls_self_signed: Self-signed certificate — no public issuer vouches for it.
f_tls_hostname_mismatch: Certificate is not valid for {host} — hostname check failed.
f_tls_expired_chain: A certificate in the chain has expired.
f_tls_protocol_12: Negotiated TLS 1.2 — solid, TLS 1.3 is the current recommendation.
f_tls_hostname_not_in_san: {host} is not among the certificate's SAN entries.
f_tls_expiring_urgent: Certificate expires in {days} days — renew urgently.
f_tls_expiry_ok: Certificate is valid for {days} more days.
f_tls_expiry_unparsed: Could not parse the expiry date.
f_tls_details_unavailable: Certificate details unavailable without a trusted chain.
err_target_too_long: Input is too long for a domain name.
err_bad_target: That is not a valid domain name.
err_bad_ip: That is not a valid IP address.
err_private_target: Target is in a private address range and is blocked. Can be allowed in the add-on options.
err_too_many_values: Too many values in one field.
err_worker_tls: TLS error talking to the root-server worker.
err_worker_timeout: Root-server worker did not answer in time.
err_worker_auth: Root-server worker rejected the access token.
err_worker_bad_response: Root-server worker sent an unreadable response.
err_worker_disabled: Worker mode is not enabled on this server.
err_rate_limited: Too many checks in a short time — please wait a moment.
err_csrf: Form expired. Please reload the page.
err_ipv6_unsupported: Most blocklists do not index IPv6 — only IPv4 can be checked.
err_unexpected_response: Operator answered unexpectedly — not a normal listing code.
